comments.author: leeoniya
comments.why: Taycan repeated launches without performance loss
comments.text: > The Bugattis and Aston Martins alike are engineered to lap tracks or do speed runs over and over again in comfort and luxury without any reduction in acceleration or braking performance while Tesla's drive-train reaches its thermal limits really fast if you push it and reduces its performance accordingly. a problem the Porsche Taycan solves (to some extent).
